body: SPEC'D 2026-07-23 (reframed by Andrew: piggyback on real in-flight Workflow fan-outs, NOT a standalone matrix). Split fan-out agents into 3 buckets on the IDENTICAL subtask -> judge scores all 3 -> append quality/cost/speed to conversations/openweight-scoreboard.jsonl. Buckets: Anthropic (model:sonnet/fable, flat Max), GPT (agentType:codex, flat Codex sub), open-weight (headless `claude -p` via translation proxy -> OpenRouter, pay-per-token, NEVER touches Max). VERIFIED (Context7/CC source): Claude Code speaks only Anthropic /v1/messages; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL must be Anthropic-compatible; OpenRouter is OpenAI-format so needs a proxy (LiteLLM or claude-code-router); env is per-process so open-weight terminal never uses the sub; Workflow model override is Anthropic-only so open-weight bucket MUST shell out. SHARES INFRA with idea_2 (proxy + OPENROUTER_API_KEY dotfile + `ow-run` wrapper = idea_2's launcher in headless form) — build once. ACCEPTANCE (see spec): (1) ow-run completes from glm-5.2 AND kimi-k3 via proxy w/ token+wallclock; (2) prove OpenRouter charge + zero Anthropic-sub delta; (3) 3-bucket harness runs in ONE real fan-out, appends 3 rows; (4) judge scores all 3 + eyes-on open-weight render; (5) >=N datapoints/bucket before ANY routing-ladder edit; (6) non-goals held. title: Grab: live optimistic DOM move preview (DevTools-style drag) backed by real source edits
detail: DevTools can drag a div live via CDP DOM.moveTo but the move is ephemeral. Raven overlay runs in-page so insertBefore gives the same instant canvas feel with no CDP: drag in Layers tree (or directly on canvas) -> element moves immediately as optimistic preview -> pending-changes tray holds the source-edit intent -> agent applies, reconcile via existing domSnapshotHash machinery; discard restores. Extends the existing style-edit live-preview pattern to structure. Hazards: framework re-render replacing moved node mid-drag (detached-row guards exist), drop-target ambiguity (insertion markers like DevTools).
